stage1.impression: A moody, convincing dawn mood: the fog pouring between distant ridges and the backlit grass have real atmosphere, and the depth from foreground to distance works. The product is the weak point. The clear cabinet stands against bright fog, so it reads as a grey, low-contrast box with a flat white woofer ring. Its base is lost in grass with no visible contact, and the sparse, clumpy tufts on bare dirt and the tan dune-like hills read more as a desert render than a headland.

blocking_9: The cabinet (y 335-590) must stand against dark grass, not bright fog: the background directly beside the cabinet should be lum_median <= 90, while the horn can stay against the fog
The cabinet's outer edges need a clear silhouette: an edge step of at least 50 lum at the left and right cabinet edges
The feet must visibly stand on ground with a contact shadow, with no grass blades crossing the base
The near ground must read as a dense coastal grass meadow, not single tufts on bare dirt, with no repeated clump shapes
The far hills must read as grassy Marin-like headlands at kilometre scale, not tan sand dunes
The acrylic must catch the low sun as rim light or edge glow, so it reads as clear cast acrylic rather than grey glass

defects.what: Clear cabinet silhouetted against bright fog (bg lum ~180-203): it washes out and reads grey; the left edge step is only 20 lum
Base hidden behind grass tufts; no contact shadow or ground bounce visible, so the speaker looks planted behind the grass rather than on the ground
White woofer ring reads as flat, untextured CG white with no light falloff; the front face sits in shadow (lum_median 66) with no fill
Near ground: sparse, evenly spaced, similar grass clumps on bare brown dirt; repetitive and desert-like rather than a headland meadow
Hills across the water are tan and smooth like sand dunes (measured RGB 122,118,96); they lose kilometre scale and read as a miniature
Top band of the sky is flat and featureless (lum range 30); acceptable as room for type, but slightly dead
Thin, bright wisp band right at the brow line flattens the grass edge into a hard light/dark seam
